quote:
The best **** game of all time…

Don’t let any of these brokies who haven’t played the fame fool you. The start is slow but it needs to be with the way everything plays out. The story and action is the best there has ever been in any media EVER.

author: Dawindo
quote: Nintendo's remake feels like a fresh coat of paint on an old house. The graphics look nice, but the game feels soulless and mass-produced. Without voice acting, the story falls flat and the characters never truly come alive. The puzzles are so easy you rarely have to think. Strip away the Zelda name and the nostalgia, and there's honestly nothing here other action-adventure games don't do just as well or better.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
